notes: PHL628 is the only strain; its genotype is not given, so genotype_class/strain_group left out. Rhamnose (and glucose in M9) are carbon supplements -> treatment none; every sample is plain growth of the one strain in a medium, so all are controls (submitters' 'control' = no sugar in LB, glucose in M9). Planktonic culture mode not described (static vs shaken unknown); planktonic cells after 48 h -> late_stationary (inferred); biofilm -> not_applicable. Oxygen not stated. | 2026-11-20: planktonic cells set to growth_phase not_applicable instead of late_stationary: they are the free-swimming fraction of a 48 h biofilm culture (culture mode not described), not a batch culture in a growth phase.

treatment.q: supplemented with either L-rhamnose at 0.5% (w/w), no sugar (0%, LB samples), or 0.5% (w/w) D-glucose (M9 samples)

is_control.q: PHL628 E coli cells were grown in either LB or M9 media supplemented with rhamnose or no additional sugar or 0.5% glucose

inducer_added.q: three biological replicates of planktonic and biofilm samples of each experimental condition type were harvested

transcription_arrested.q: three biological replicates of planktonic and biofilm samples of each experimental condition type were harvested

mixed_organism.q: three biological replicates of planktonic and biofilm samples of each experimental condition type were harvested

assay_class.q: rRNA removal by using Ribo-Zero Plus rRNA Depletion Kit (Illumina)

rrna_removal.q: rRNA removal by using Ribo-Zero Plus rRNA Depletion Kit (Illumina)

growth_phase.q: Cells were grown at 28 or 37 C for 48 h and harvested as biofilm cells or planktonic (swimming) cells.
